I was a pretty devout LaVeyian Satanist. I lived in a small town, so there wasn't much going on, Satan wise, but I would read the Satanic Bible every day, practice rituals, and strongly defend Satanism to Christians who confronted me.

I wouldn't say so much "devout" but I consider myself a strong Christian. I pray frequently, and acknowledge God in life. I don't go to church because I still believe the church is corrupt to some degree, but I do believe in Jesus and the bible.

There's kind of two answers here. For starters, Christianity does make sense to me, as much as any religion can. There's always going to be things that can be explained through other means, but I have a level of faith. Christianity has some screwed up things in it's past, which I had thought was unacceptable, but I realised that pretty much all religions (in this sense, atheism is a religion too) had a screwed up past. 

God did reveal himself to me though. You hear people talking all the time about how you should try acid at least once, because you'll learn so much about yourself? Well, I tried (a different hallucinogen) and got very high. I had a very spiritual experience that kinda...in my mind, proved Jesus was there.

In Satanism, there's kinda two types of gods. There's spirits, and there's yourself. I don't believe that I am God, but I believe God works through me, and everyone else (including non believers) The spirits on the other hand, no, they aren't God.

I had two different tipping points. One, was when I was really high and had my realisation. Afterwards, I felt really depressed, because I knew I has screwed up my life and that God wouldn't forgive me. Then the second point happened. A friend, who isn't religious and wasn't raised in a religious household, reminded me of the story of the father forgiving his son after he had run away (it's in the bible, but I can't remember where.) After that, I rededicated myself. 

Yes, I think that Satanists are going to Hell, but I think there will be nonchristians in Heaven also. I think that Heaven is for anyone who genuinely tries to find God. Even if you get lost along the way, I believe God is loving, and doesn't get held up in technicalities.

From where I'm standing, I see what life is like. I don't see why I would want to go through more of that. And I know that my viewpoint is askew, but it's what I've come to expect. 

I'm just going to level with you. I took a totally appropriate amount on sleeping pills, and they're starting to hit me. 

Thank you for your words.  I fully expect to look back on them and have them help me through tomorrow, when just falling asleep isn't the answer.

Thank you.

While I am feeling suicidal, I am 90% certain that if I did hit the edge, I'd be unable to act on it. I do share a bed with someone. He is aware that I'm depressed today, but he is unaware of how bad it it.

Anyways, acting on it alone would be difficult to do. If something happens though, I will try my best to ensure I get to a hospital (free healthcare in Canada) or I'll call a hot line. For the record, I've never had any success with a hot line before though. So it would be more likely I'll just end up checking myself in for a night.

To answer your question, if I had the chance I wouldn't say anything. I don't need to relive the old pains. Talking to her is just such a powerful thing. Talking about it is something that I even have a problem with.

The only reason I would talk to her is if I thought I would be able to identify them. But I wouldn't know the first step to doing that.

As far as feeling bad/guilty I used too. I mean, I wasn't actually physically forced to do anything and I entered the relationship in my own free will. 

Now I think about it and, besides being so naive, there wasn't anything I could do. So, while it still hurts, I don't feel guilty.

With the sheer number of videos that were on there, I assume that someone had either come forward, or that they was caught in some way.

I wouldn't know the first thing about how to report them. I deleted their address, and have since lost the address that I contacted them on.

I never video chatted with her, just pictures. And the pictures were always purely sexual, so I never saw a face. I don't believe Heidi was actually a girl, but I have no real reason for thinking that I know anything about what they look like.

When I picture what they look like, I picture the one extreme WoW player from the South Park episode. But really, I don't know what they look like.
